name: domi-workbench
author: Domi Team
description: 豆米：面向投资团队的 Mac 桌面端 AI Agent 工作台。

scripts.dev: DOMI_INSTALL_BUNDLED_PLUGIN=1 concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.check: npm run privacy:check && npm run build && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/codex-app-server.cjs && node --check electron/codex-run-context.cjs && node --check electron/codex-turn-status.cjs && node --check electron/app-settings.cjs && node --check electron/domi-integration.cjs && node --check electron/local-domi-repository.cjs && node --check electron/local-to-feishu-migration.cjs && node --check electron/markdown-assets.cjs && node --check electron/domi-plugin-manager.cjs && node --check electron/domi-plugin-updater.cjs && node --check electron/plaud-worker.cjs && node --check electron/service-coordinator.cjs && node --check electron/state-store.cjs && node --check electron/update-service.cjs && node --check scripts/prepare-domi-plugin.cjs && node scripts/renderer-resilience.test.cjs && node scripts/app-settings.test.cjs && node scripts/codex-app-server.test.cjs && node scripts/codex-run-context.test.cjs && node scripts/codex-turn-status.test.cjs && node scripts/domi-integration.test.cjs && node scripts/local-to-feishu-migration.test.cjs && node scripts/domi-plugin-manager.test.cjs && node scripts/domi-plugin-updater.test.cjs && node scripts/markdown-assets.test.cjs && node scripts/radar-workflow.test.cjs && node scripts/service-coordinator.test.cjs && node scripts/state-store.test.cjs
scripts.pack:mac: npm run plugin:prepare && npm run build && npm run icon:mac && bash scripts/package-mac.sh dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run plugin:prepare:release && npm run privacy:check && npm run build && npm run icon:mac && bash scripts/package-mac.sh dist
scripts.dist:mac:resume: npm run privacy:check && bash scripts/package-mac.sh resume

extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: 豆米需要在文稿目录创建本地项目工作区并保存任务成果。
